rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice when something is too painful or unpleasant to put up with.

example.english: The heat lately is unbearable for me.
example.traditional: 呢排咁熱，我真係頂唔順。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 gam3 jit6 ngo5 zan1 hai6 ding2 m4 seon6

rows.note: Use this as a compact description of an experience, situation, or thing that is hard to endure.

example.english: The traffic on this journey is unbearable.
example.traditional: 呢程車塞到郁唔到，真係難頂。
example.jyutping: ni1 cing4 ce1 sak1 dou3 juk1 m4 dou3 zan1 hai6 naan4 ding2

rows.note: Use this formal phrasing especially in writing or careful speech rather than casual conversation.

example.english: The report points out that prolonged noise is unbearable for residents.
example.traditional: 呢份報告指出，長期噪音對居民而言難以忍受。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 bou3 gou3 zi2 ceot1 coeng4 kei4 cou3 jam1 deoi3 geoi1 man4 ji4 jin4 naan4 ji5 jan2 sau6
